name: use-rule-editor
title: useRuleEditor
description: The editor state of one rule in the active organization: its condition tree, validation, dirty state and save, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the rules block (`npx better-supabase add rules`), a field catalog synced with `createRulesAdmin().syncFields()`, `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. The Rule builder recipe renders it. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/automations#editor.
